chunks: Whatever is in this book from ʿAlī ibn Bilāl, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from ʿAlī ibn Bilāl.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: may Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for a narrator
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement of direct narration by the compiler
key_terms.مَا كَانَ فِي هَ: whatever is in this book; a reference to the compiler’s contents

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for the reports narrated from ʿAlī ibn Bilāl in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn Bilāl in this book. It serves as a chain-verification statement, identifying the intermediary narrators and preserving the transmission history of the hadith material.
